summary.text: Zach Duckworth is a Republican state senator from Lakeville, Minnesota, who represents District 57 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, against Democrat Steven Schroer.
He is a Minnesota Army National Guard officer whose career includes work in real estate and business ownership.

paragraphs.text: Duckworth lives in Lakeville, Minnesota, and earned a B.A. in 2009 and an M.B.A. in 2015, both from the University of St. Thomas.
He joined the Minnesota Army National Guard and had reached the rank of Major by 2023, and his career experience includes working in the real estate industry and owning a business.

Duckworth first won election to the Minnesota State Senate in 2020, when he defeated incumbent Matt Little in District 58, and he won District 57 in 2022 with 58.6 percent of the vote over Jackie L. Craig.

His 2025-2026 committee assignments are Agriculture and Rural Development Finance and Policy, Commerce and Consumer Protection Finance and Policy, Education Policy, and Higher Education Finance and Policy, where he is the Ranking Minority Member.
